items.q: What did Levent Alpagay claim with Claude's help?
items.a: A proof of the **Riemann hypothesis**, delivered as **17 million lines of Lean** after a **41-day Claude conversation**.

items.q: Why did the Lean community first accept the proof?
items.a: Because it **compiled**: Lean won't compile unless each **stated step is logically valid**.

items.q: What flaw did a mathematician find in the Lean code?
items.a: A geometry check that **just returned true**, used **118 times**; it turned out to be mostly **leftover slop**.

items.q: Why is a compiled proof still unsatisfying?
items.a: There is **no human-readable version**, so **nobody understands why it works**, including the author.

items.q: What does the Riemann episode teach about verified AI output?
items.a: A green check only covers **what you actually stated**; **review the specs and stubs**, not just the passing build.

items.q: What did Anthropic publish with Claude as sole author?
items.a: A **VP vs VNP** proof with **73,000 lines of Lean** that **no human mathematician has checked** yet.
